CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Football.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

5. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   D. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
